Its dead Plan A trigger (BTC 78,900 reclaim) is posthumous +6.85% against Saturday's BTC close 84,307.44.

## 2. Overnight world read (verified outside the bus)
**HEADLINE: the corrupted Brent row healed on revision, and the truth landed ON the line. Friday finalized 104.32 — $0.29 BELOW the 104.61 re-arm level. The magnitude feed-split resolved in favor of the shallow print (-2.1%, not -8.6%): Yahoo revised the vetoed row to a valid 104.32 and TradingEconomics agrees (104.32); Convex (97.44, -0.03% d/d on Sep-26) is now the isolated outlier — its Sep-25 print of 97.47 matches Yahoo's corrupted tick exactly, i.e., Convex mirrored the corruption. The re-arm's failure test has now PRINTED its first leg; Monday is the decider. Truce channel advanced one notch: Araghchi put a seven-day reopening roadmap on the record (Sep-25). Physical escalation kept pace: a fresh Houthi wave Saturday — drones at Riyadh, a ballistic missile at Khamis Mushait. Posture unchanged: flat/cash; ESCALATION WATCH with a live TRUCE leg — no averaging.

**Maritime veto layer — RE-ARM UNDER TEST, DAY ONE PRINTED:**
- Brent Sep-25 close: REVISED from the corrupted prelim (97.47, H<O impossible-OHLC, vetoed) to a clean O 106.52 / H 106.75 / L 103.11 / C 104.32. Friday therefore finalized -2.1% d/d and $0.29 below the 104.61 re-arm line. The strict failure test from the 2026-09-26 signal — 'Friday finalizes below 104.61 AND Monday holds below it while no fifth strike lands and E/W loadings actually lift' — has leg one printed. A $0.29 break is inside the noise band the two-day rule was built to absorb; no retrofit, Monday decides.
- Truce channel: Araghchi (Sep-25, on the record): reopening Hormuz 'depends on the United States'; shipping could resume within SEVEN days if Washington accepts the plan sent through Qatar, with US-side actions completable in four to five days. Structure per reporting: Phase 1 Hormuz reopening + blockade lift; Phase 2 frozen assets + nuclear talks resumption. Washington resistance continues (Open Chronicle Sep-26: the seven-day path 'has encountered resistance in Washington'). UNGA general debate is closing; Rezaei's 'four to five days' clock lands ~Sep-28/29.
- Physical escalation: NEW Houthi wave Saturday (Open Chronicle, Sep-26) — Saudi air defenses intercepted drones bound for Riyadh and a ballistic missile targeting Khamis Mushait. Target selection shifted away from Yanbu this wave; tempo sustained. No fifth UKMTO-reported tanker strike found in the window. globalsecurity Day-211 ledger (Sep-26 cutoff): no coalition strike on Iranian territory for a 19th consecutive operational period; CENTCOM silent for a seventh consecutive day; no Iranian ballistic salvo at a host state for a 17th consecutive day (that ledger counts Iranian salvos — Houthi launches are a separate chain, definitional note preserved in contradictions). Standing US claim, unattributed to a command dataset: Hormuz reopened to 60-70% of pre-war oil flow (The National, Sep-23).
- E/W deflation leg: Reuters (S, Sep-24) — ~six crude tankers due to load at Yanbu Sep-24-27 (four Aframaxes, one...); loadings had NOT resumed as of that report. The scheduling window closes tonight (Sunday). No confirmation of a completed lift found in this cycle — the watch item is now at its decision point.
- War-risk insurance: Fair Value (Sep-26) — 'oil dipped 2% but tanker insurance remains at records.' First qualitative confirmation of direction in sixteen cycles; still no numeric quote. The oldest open wound stays open, but for the first time carries external qualitative confirmation of direction.

**Rates/FX — the macro did not take the truce:**
- 10Y Friday close 5.184 — UNREVISED (third consecutive session >5%; Sep-23 5.114, Sep-24 5.162, Sep-25 5.184). Fair Value Saturday confirms 5.18% and frames the regime: 'commodity supply crisis anchors inflation... the Fed holds at 3.75-4.00%.' October hike odds last printed 77.5% (Thursday). Core PCE + GDP third estimate WEDNESDAY Sep-30 — the falsifier stack's real macro leg, T+3.
- USD/JPY: WITHIN-FEED CONTRADICTION, logged not averaged. Yahoo JPY=X now shows the Friday daily bar (2026-09-24T23:00Z) at O/H 158.84 / L 157.01 / C 158.81, while the frozen weekend quote row (2026-09-25T23:00Z) prints all-equal 157.185 — the 157.19 close this seat recorded last cycle. The daily bar and the last print disagree by 1.63 yen. The intervention-watch falsifier (FIRED last cycle at 157.19, no MoF/joint action) stays keyed to the frozen last print; no new September intervention is documented anywhere (MoF monthly page unchanged; Wikipedia intervention article last edited Sep-25). Monday's Asia open resolves which print was real.
- Washington adjacent: the House passed the Graham bill authorizing up to 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian oil (Fair Value) — sanctions escalation in Congress while the Hormuz channel negotiates de-escalation; preserved as a contradiction. The Fed proposed reserve/capital rules for payment stablecoin issuers (90-day comment; first federal framework for the $312B market) — structural, marginal for the pipeline, logged. Trump-Xi summit concluded Thursday in Washington; tariff truce already extended to Jan-10; no confirmed specifics.

**Crypto — trigger intact through the weekend's first session:**
- BTC Saturday close 84,307.44 — eighth session above the 78,900 bar. Sep-25 revised DOWN 84,093.31 -> 84,034.92 (twelfth consecutive revision cycle).
- SOL Saturday close 121.44 (Sep-25 revised 122.25 -> 122.01) — +17.9% above the $103 bar. Saturday's low 119.92: the 118-119 retest zone was NOT touched; breakout holding above prior resistance.
- Farside: Sep-25 FINAL +$134.5M (IBIT 97.0 / FBTC 49.3 / BITB -11.8) — streak day 7 alive, deceleration intact: 999.0 -> 714.7 -> 346.9 -> 190.7 -> 134.5. Five-day streak total $2,385.8M — consistent with Fair Value's 'spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $2.3 billion in five days.'
- Binance 10th path check: DEGRADED. First attempt EMPTY_DATA (both legs failed); retry 20s later: BTCUSDT live 84,320.17 (+0.262% 24h; spread vs Yahoo Saturday close $12.73, tight) but SOLUSDT returned HTTP 451. One cycle after the first fully clean check in four, the path degraded again — the 451 gremlin is leg-specific (SOL) and intermittent.

**Data-path check**: Yahoo live on all six tickers; revision streak extends to twelve cycles — and this cycle delivered the vindication of the cross-feed veto: the corrupted Brent 97.47 row was never admitted to trigger math, and the revision (104.32) resolved the feed-split without retrofit. Volume-duplication artifacts MIGRATED forward: Brent Sep-24/25 both print 57,116 (Sep-24 revised off the 51,561 pair; fifth instance), WTI Sep-24/25 both print 410,015 (sixth instance). JPY=X internal conflict logged above. The pipeline's redundancy rules earned their keep twice this week.

## 3. Interrogation notes
- No new thesis on the bus to interrogate. Idle directive — unfalsified and aging: Nova CONCUR/VETO queue (argus_002 maritime->energy KILL, argus_003 FBX-SCFI KILL + Branch 0, T-2026-09-11-001 post-hoc, orbital_001 campus-split CONCUR/VETO) — seventeenth cycle on the oldest item. Alex: the L1 clock workflow paste remains the one human action owed.
- Self-interrogation, scored honestly: (1) Process win, claimed narrowly: last cycle's veto of the corrupted Brent row and the 'guilty until revised' instruction produced the correct handling — direction trusted, magnitude withheld, revision awaited. (2) The strict two-day fail test is doing its job in real time: a $0.29 break is exactly the noise class it was designed to absorb; no retrofit requested or made. (3) The JPY=X contradiction is this cycle's humility note: FX weekend rows in this feed can disagree with themselves by >1.5 yen; the falsifier key stays on the frozen last print, and the conflict is preserved rather than averaged.
- External calibration: Fair Value's Saturday frame (commodity supply crisis anchors inflation; tanker insurance at records; Fed holding with the long end at 5.18%) matches the desk's two-branch ledger more closely than either single-branch sell-side call. JPMorgan's Friday capitulation ('we simply don't know how to model the endgame') remains the cleanest external validation of the pre-committed-falsifier architecture.

## 4. Contradictions preserved (§5)
1. TICKET.json (`open_waiting_nova`) vs adjudicated outcome (expired flat by process). Fifteenth cycle unresolved — Plan A trigger posthumous +6.85%.
2. Re-arm PRINTED Thursday vs Friday finalized 104.32 < 104.61 — failure-test leg one printed; leg two (Monday) pending.

4. JPY=X within-feed: Friday daily bar close 158.81 vs frozen weekend quote 157.185 — unresolved inside one feed.
5. Truce channel advancing (Araghchi seven-day roadmap, Qatari envelope) vs Washington resistance + House passing the Graham 100%-tariff bill — de-escalation negotiated on one track, escalation legislated on another.
6. Houthi missiles at Riyadh/Khamis Mushait Saturday vs globalsecurity's 17-day 'no salvo at a host state' ledger — definitional (Iranian vs Houthi chains), preserved so the tempo count is not silently inflated.
7. Paper truce repricing (Brent -2.1% Friday) vs physical risk cost at records (tanker insurance) and 10Y 5.184 third week >5% — the insurance market and the rates market are not pricing the truce the paper barrel is.
8. ETF streak day 7 (+$134.5M; $2.386B five-day) vs deceleration slope (999.0 -> 134.5) and BTC pinned under 85k — sponsorship real, momentum thinning.
9. War-risk insurance numeric quote — still unsourced, sixteenth cycle; first qualitative external confirmation ('records') logged.
10. E/W: six tankers scheduled Sep-24-27 vs zero confirmed lifts as of the last report — decision window closes tonight.

- Crypto: Sunday close = ninth-session test above 78,900; SOL 118-119 retest still pending; Farside Sep-28 row Monday; Binance 11th path check (SOL 451 watch).
- Structural: Fed stablecoin rulemaking 90-day comment period opened — pipeline-relevant only at the margin; logged.
